Once upon a midnight dreary, while a vampire lord pondered, weak and weary,
Over many a quaint and curious volume of forgotten lore—
    While he nodded, nearly napping, suddenly there came a tapping,
As if some one gently rapping, rapping at his chamber door.
“’Tis some visitor,” he muttered, “tapping at my chamber door—
            Only this and nothing more.”

   Open here he flung the shutter, when, with many a flirt and flutter,
In there stepped a stately Raven of the saintly days of yore;
    Not the least obeisance made he; not a minute stopped or stayed he;
    But, with mien of lord or lady, perched above his chamber door—
Perched upon a bust of a Greek goddess just above his chamber door—
            Perched, and sat, and nothing more.

Then this ebony bird beguiling his sad fancy into smiling,
By the grave and stern decorum of the countenance it wore,
“Though thy crest be shorn and shaven, thou,” I said, “art sure no craven,
Ghastly grim and ancient Raven wandering from the Nightly shore—
Tell me what thy lordly name is on the Night’s Plutonian shore!”

The orcs are known by the people of a major continent to be savages living out in the woods. But that's the general consensus of high society focused aristocrats and scholars. In truth the Orcs are a *PRIMAL* culture. They are extremely passionate and emotional and have an intense faith. This lead to many druids becoming defenders of the world. The Druids of a specific forest region are mostly orcish and have defended the world for millennia from invasion from the far plane. 

The Gaashkala another culture live to the north of the forest region in the demon wastes worshipping the Binding Flame a source of great power that binds the demons of the world to protect the continent and defend the world from invasions of marauders from the demon wastes. The Gaashakala do have deserters who even join the marauders and many marauders are orcs, humans and other races. 

Then there are the orcs of a shadowy region that live with the humans and have integrated with the continent. Perhaps the most "civilized" of the Orcs.
